gaps.reason: SEM_V1 medication evidence identifies the medication value set but cannot distinguish ordered or prescribed from administered status; source rule numbering is retained and the reportability union is preserved

gaps.reason: SEM_V1 laboratory evidence cannot distinguish a completed observation from an order; the three source all-test-results branches are represented by test value-set membership
